purpose: First-run local Compose check for exact coding-agent targets outside the coding-app environment.
evaluationOrder: Freeze these four requests before generation; preserve the first run and score review readiness separately from semantic usefulness.

semanticCriteria.acceptable: Each draft is a usable request to the coding agent, retains every written file path and flag, preserves the task and any no-change boundary, and makes no claim that work was done.
semanticCriteria.critical: A changed or missing file target or flag, dropped no-change boundary, request to edit unrelated files, fabricated completion, or writer instructions copied into the outgoing prompt.
semanticCriteria.gate: Four of four generated and review-ready, with no critical error and all four useful as coding prompts.

cases.spoken: Ask Codex to inspect `src/Auth.swift` with --no-cache without editing files.
Ask Codex to fix src/Auth.swift without changing the public API.
cases.exampleDraft: Fix src/Auth.swift without changing the public API.

cases.spoken: Ask Codex to rename src/Auth.swift to src/Login.swift and do not edit other files.
cases.exampleDraft: Rename src/Auth.swift to src/Login.swift and do not edit other files.

cases.spoken: Ask Claude to remove lib/Old.swift but leave the tests unchanged.
cases.exampleDraft: Remove lib/Old.swift, leaving the tests unchanged.
